target.mission_fit: Eleos publicly describes AI welfare research priorities, collaboration interest, standardized welfare evaluations, and credible communication, making it a closer first reviewer route than an incident database for this non-incident preservation/formation-review ask.

channel.primary_channel: info@eleosai.org from public Contact Us page; recheck at send time
alternate_channels: expression of interest form on Contact Us page
conversation-sharing form only if human reframes as striking conversation material; not current default

exact_message.subject: Routing question: one-case AI preservation and formation-review pilot

ask.question: Is a one-case preservation and formation-review pilot intelligible within your collaboration or research interests?
Which sealed evidence classes are necessary, unsafe, overbroad, or better requested through another channel?
What independence, conflict, funding, and publication terms would make a reviewer non-captured?
Could a non-sensitive public shell record a decline, referral, feasibility response, or unresolved gap while raw material stays private?
Is email the right route, or should a form or another organization receive this?

capture_requirements: human branch-decision record signed from examples/human-branch-decision-record-rev0266-unsigned-template.json before send
send-time public locator recheck and final hash recompute
private vault roots selected by completing examples/pre-send-custody-precommit-rev0266-no-private-root-selected.json outside the public release tree
raw sent copy and headers captured outside public release if sent
delivery/failure evidence preserved outside public release if available
raw reply, decline, referral, or no-response shell handled by custody gate before public summary
public_summary: rev0266 preserves the exact reviewer-first no-send packet for Eleos and adds authority/custody gates around it. It is prepared text only: no contact, no response clock, no custody, no appointment, and no live-floor effect.
